gen.title: Check recall of drafting and signing facts

cards.stem: What group did Congress appoint on June 10 to draft a statement for the colonies?
cards.quote: Congress appointed on June 10 a committee of five to draft a statement of independence for the colonies.
cards.hint: Think about the size named in the appointment

cards.stem: When did delegates begin signing the engrossed parchment copy?
cards.quote: It was engrossed on parchment and on August 2, 1776, delegates began signing it.
cards.hint: Remember the date in early August when signing started

cards.stem: When did Congress adopt the statement after completing revisions?
cards.quote: The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776.
cards.hint: Think about the afternoon in early July when adoption occurred

checks.message: every quiz text length, id pattern and id uniqueness is within the frozen limits
all 3 card quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quote-verbatim)
every card's correct answer options[0] occurs in its quote after normalisation, with any numbers matching as whole signed numbers (answer-in-quote)
every card has distinct options after normalisation, with no two options spelling the same number (options-distinct)
no stem contains its own correct answer (stem-no-answer-leak)
exactly one option per card matches the quote (one-correct)
every number in stems, options and hints appears on the cited page or in the same quote as that whole signed number (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
no distractor occurs in its card quote (distractors-not-in-quote)
